Inputs:

import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    w = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    # Calculate recent trend: mean power and mean wind speed
    avg_p = np.mean(history_windows[:, :, t], axis=1)
    avg_w = np.mean(history_windows[:, :, w], axis=1)
    # Use a simple power curve approximation: cubic relation between wind speed and power

    p_max = np.percentile(train_series[target_col], 95)
    w_max = np.percentile(train_series["Wspd"], 95) + 1e-6

    recent_p = np.median(history_windows[:, -24:, t], axis=1)
    g_mean = train_series[target_col].mean()
    # Blend: 40% recent trend, 30% physical estimate, 30% long-term turbine mean
    preds = 0.4 * recent_p + 0.3 * np.clip(est_p, 0, p_max) + 0.3 * g_mean
